book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Hegam anghil matsh wo uꞌapa g si oidchkam shoꞌigdag
Ntki hahawa ep nei g si geꞌe chehgida an dahm kahchim ch ed. Wewaꞌak anghil oki uꞌa g wewaꞌak shoꞌigdag. Idam oki d si ha oidchkam shoꞌigdag. Jiosh atki id hekaj am wo i kuhgi g s-gewk e-aꞌappemadag.

Neid ani mo am haꞌichu tadani ch hab sha mahs mo g mi-lihda ch g mehi wehnags. Ha ani ep neid hegam mat gewito hegai s-ta Ehbidamakam pi ab hu has elidch g wepogidaj ch ab hu cheposig heg hekaj chehgigaj ch nuhmilo. Am oki gegok hugidaj an ihda mo sha mi-lihda mahs ch g aꞌalpa an uꞌukch mat g Jiosh ab ha mah.
Mosesbad ch hegai mo kahwalkaj ab e chehgidch oki ab ha mahkch g neꞌi. K id am aꞌaga:

content.text: K g haꞌichu hab m-juni d si geꞌe haꞌichu ch shaꞌi si s-kehgaj.
T-kownalig an wehsko jewed dahm, do si s-apꞌekam ch wohokam g m-himdag.
Wehsijj att ab wo si has i m-el.
Pi at hedai wo shaꞌi pi am hu ah map d si haꞌichu nap pi ahpi d si hekia s-apꞌekam.
Wehs nahnko mahs hemajkam at ab wo i hihim k ab wo i shul m-wui no pi wehsijj neid g si s-apꞌekam haꞌichu hab m-juni.”

content: Am i dahm ani hahawa ep neid moki ab kuhpiꞌokas g Jiosh cheopiga an dahm kahchim ch ed. Kuki heg eda am haꞌichug hegai ikus kih mo hab d ahga mo g Jiosh am ha wehmaj g e-hemajkamga.
Tki ab i wuwha g wewaꞌak anghil k uꞌa g wewaꞌak si oidchkam shoꞌigdag ab amjed g cheopi. Idam anghil oki si s-kehg s-tohtam e enigadadch ch g ohla babshodag an hab juhkch e-babsho an.
Tki hema hegam giꞌik haꞌichu doakam ab ha mah idam wewaꞌak anghil g wewaꞌak ohla hohas-hahaꞌa. Kuki idam shuhshudch g s-koꞌok namkidadag.

Hegai cheopi o ab wabsh i shuhdags g kuhbskaj no pi am haꞌichug g s-tondam gewkdaj g Jiosh. Kut pi hedai wo e nako mas an hu wo i wah cheopi ch ed am hugkam mat wo kuhgi idam wewaꞌak shoꞌigdag mat uꞌapa hegam wewaꞌak anghil.
